This unprecedented growth directly impacts Chatsworth property owners who are increasingly installing residential and commercial EV charging stations.

Electrical Panel Upgrades: Meeting 2025 Code Requirements

The 2025 California Electrical Code, adopted on September 11, 2024, by the California Energy Commission, introduces several critical updates that affect panel upgrades throughout Chatsworth. Many homes in the area were built with 100-amp or 150-amp electrical panels that are insufficient for modern electrical demands, especially when adding EV chargers, pool equipment, home additions, or upgraded HVAC systems. Shaffer Construction has extensive experience upgrading electrical panels in Chatsworth homes to meet current code requirements and accommodate increased electrical loads.

According to 2025 California Electrical Code updates, replacement panelboards must now pass factory short-circuit tests before installation, and the listing label must remain visible after retrofit. Additionally, the code requires minimum working clearance in front of service panels of 30 inches wide by 36 inches deep, ensuring safe access for maintenance and emergency situations. All panels must have permanent, legible circuit labels, a requirement that Shaffer Construction meticulously follows on every panel upgrade project in Chatsworth.

One of the most significant changes for Chatsworth homeowners is the future-ready requirement. New homes and major renovations must now include panel capacity and conduit pathways for solar and battery upgrades, plus a 240-volt line for a Level 2 EV charger. Even if you're not installing an EV charger immediately, Shaffer Construction recommends including this infrastructure during panel upgrades to avoid costly retrofits later. Our electrical load study services help Chatsworth property owners understand their current and future electrical needs, ensuring panel upgrades are properly sized for long-term use.

Grounding and bonding requirements have also been strengthened under the 2025 code. The grounding electrode conductor must be installed in one continuous length without splices or joints, and both metallic water piping and gas piping inside buildings are required to be bonded. These safety measures protect Chatsworth homes from electrical faults and lightning strikes. Shaffer Construction's licensed electricians ensure every panel upgrade meets or exceeds these safety standards, providing peace of mind for homeowners throughout Chatsworth and the greater Los Angeles area.

Commercial Electrical Services for Chatsworth Businesses

Chatsworth's diverse business community, from manufacturing facilities to retail establishments, requires specialized commercial electrical services that differ significantly from residential work. Commercial electrical systems operate at higher voltages, typically 120V to 480V compared to residential systems' 120V to 240V, and often utilize three-phase power for greater efficiency. Shaffer Construction has the expertise and licensing to handle commercial electrical projects of all sizes throughout Chatsworth and Los Angeles County.

As outlined in our article on preparing Los Angeles buildings for the EV charging boom, commercial properties face unique challenges when adding electrical infrastructure. Load calculations are critical for commercial projects, following NEC Article 220 guidelines to accurately size branch circuits, feeders, and service equipment. Shaffer Construction provides comprehensive electrical load studies for Chatsworth businesses, calculating power requirements for lighting, heating, HVAC systems, equipment, and other electrical loads to ensure systems are correctly sized.

Emergency power systems are another crucial consideration for Chatsworth commercial properties. According to commercial electrical construction standards, commercial buildings require emergency power systems to ensure continuity of operations during power outages. Shaffer Construction designs and installs backup generator systems and uninterruptible power supply systems that meet code requirements and provide reliable emergency power when needed.

Energy efficiency has become a priority for Chatsworth businesses looking to reduce operating costs. Recent NEC updates have introduced new requirements for energy efficiency and the integration of renewable energy sources. Shaffer Construction helps Chatsworth businesses implement LED lighting retrofits, occupancy sensors, and energy management systems that significantly reduce electricity consumption while meeting current code requirements. Our commercial electrical services also include ongoing maintenance programs that keep systems operating safely and efficiently year-round.

Residential Electrical Services: Safety and Modernization

Chatsworth homeowners face various electrical challenges, from aging wiring systems to the need for additional circuits to support modern appliances and technology. The 2025 California Electrical Code has introduced new safety requirements that affect residential electrical work throughout the area. Arc-fault circuit interrupter (AFCI) breakers are now mandatory for any circuit work in habitable areas, providing enhanced protection against electrical fires. Ground-fault circuit interrupter (GFCI) protection has also been expanded to additional areas of homes, protecting residents from electrical shocks.

Tamper-resistant outlets are now mandatory in all habitable areas under the 2025 code, even in homes without children. According to electrical code updates for 2025, the code views tamper-resistant outlets as a general safety standard rather than just a childproofing measure. Shaffer Construction ensures all residential electrical work in Chatsworth incorporates these enhanced safety features, protecting families and bringing homes into full code compliance.

Many Chatsworth homes require electrical system modernization to accommodate contemporary lifestyles. Home offices require dedicated circuits for computers and equipment, home theaters need proper wiring for surround sound and large-screen televisions, and outdoor living spaces require weatherproof outlets and lighting systems. Shaffer Construction works with Chatsworth homeowners to assess their electrical needs and provide solutions that enhance functionality, safety, and property value.

Whole-home surge protection has become increasingly important as Chatsworth residents invest in expensive electronics, smart home systems, and appliances. Lightning strikes and utility company switching can send voltage surges through electrical systems, damaging sensitive equipment. Shaffer Construction installs whole-home surge protection devices at electrical panels, providing comprehensive protection that goes beyond individual surge protector power strips. This investment protects thousands of dollars worth of electronics and appliances from potentially devastating electrical surges.
